container volume create --label com.docker.compose.project=web --label com.docker.compose.volume=data web_data
container run --detach --name web-db-1 --env POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret --label com.docker.compose.container-number=1 --label com.docker.compose.oneoff=False --label com.docker.compose.project=web --label com.docker.compose.project.config_files=<DIR>/compose.yaml --label com.docker.compose.project.working_dir=<DIR> --label com.docker.compose.service=db --mount type=volume,source=web_data,target=/var/lib/postgresql/data --network back,alias=db postgres:16
# stderr: warning: services.db: healthcheck: ignored (container has no healthchecks)
